Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zisar 0.2.0

  • zero_spatial now selects the inflation predictor: "none" (restricted model), "reduced", "field" or "sar". TRUE and FALSE still work and mean "field" and "none".
  • New reduced-rank inflation field (zero_spatial = "reduced"): a SAR field on the knots of a lattice, spread over the units by a bisquare basis built by the new zisar_basis(). It is the recommended general model: the Laplace approximation of the unit-level field ("field") fails, with likelihood-ratio statistics in the thousands on data without a field.
  • New SAR filter on the inflation predictor (zero_spatial = "sar"), logit(pi) = (I - rho0 W)^{-1} Z gamma, with spillovers of the inflation covariates in zisar_effects() and predict().
  • Fits with a random inflation field start from the restricted fit and a grid of (rho0, sigma0), returned in field_profile.
  • The warning on a large gradient no longer calls the optimum spurious: with structural zeros among units of high intensity a genuine optimum has one too. Check it on data from simulate() and use a parametric bootstrap for standard errors (see vignette("zisar")). A positive log-likelihood is still reported as spurious.
  • New argument restarts = FALSE skips the restarts of a fit that fails the checks, for slow fits where a large gradient is expected.
  • rzisar() gains zero_spatial; rho0 and sigma0 now need it.
  • The README and vignette("zisar") explain the model with two figures: the two kinds of zeros and the reach of the spatial multiplier (data-raw/figures.R).

zisar 0.1.0

First release.

  • zisar() fits the ZISAR model from a two-part formula y ~ count terms | zero-inflation terms and a spatial weights matrix (base matrix, sparse Matrix or spdep listw); zisar_fit() is the matrix interface.
  • Estimation by Laplace approximation in ‘TMB’, with the log-determinant from the eigenvalues of W or, for large n, from a sparse Cholesky factor.
  • fixed holds parameters at given values, for the nested ZINB-RE (rho = 0) and SAR-NB-RE models.
  • zero_spatial = TRUE fits the general model, with a SAR random field in the zero-inflation predictor (parameters rho0 and sigma0); rzisar() simulates from it with sigma0 > 0.
  • offset() terms in the count part, for exposures.
  • Methods: summary(), coef(), vcov(), logLik() (hence AIC(), BIC()), nobs(), fitted(), residuals(), predict() (including counterfactual scenarios on the same units) and simulate().
  • zisar_effects(): average direct, indirect and total effects with simulation standard errors, including the zero-inflation channel.
  • rzisar() simulates from the model; lattice_weights() builds lattice contiguity weights.
